verdict.rationale: Supabase provides native primitives for autonomous background automation: Supabase Cron for recurring scheduled jobs, Supabase Queues for durable async processing, Database Webhooks to trigger on table events, and Edge Functions for serverless execution — all combinable to run tasks without manual triggering. These are first-party documented features usable independently of any AI-specific tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that these automations run reliably at scale, and no explicit example tying this to an AI-native/agentic workflow specifically.
